text:
Maya: heads up — multiple pages from our PagerDuty integration didn't create threads in #incidents for ~10m. PD shows delivered to ops rotation (PD-14567).

Leo: seeing the same. PD shows webhook returning 502s from pager-proxy. No Slack thread created for the PD alert.

ops-bot: incidentbot: automated suppression check returned: suppressed_duplicate=true (window=5m) for PD-14567.

Maya: customer-facing impact? Any reported errors?

Nisha: I'm oncall. Customer support pinged at 13:09 about delayed retries for payments. No inbound calls recorded to our oncall line. I attempted a manual page at 13:12 — PD shows a page but Slack stayed quiet.

Leo: tailing pager-proxy logs now — spike of 503/502 between 13:05–13:14. Sending a clipped log sample: 

```
2024-11-07T13:06:02Z pager-proxy ERROR webhook POST /pd/hook 502 upstream_timeout
2024-11-07T13:06:03Z pager-proxy ERROR webhook POST /pd/hook 503 circuit_breaker_open
2024-11-07T13:09:45Z pager-proxy INFO webhook POST /pd/hook 200 ok
```

Maya: suggests partial outage / transient upstream. Can someone restart the pager-proxy pod to clear any stuck connections?

sre-lead: I'll do a rolling restart. Running: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/pager-proxy -n infra`

ops-bot: deploybot: rollout restart started for deployment/pager-proxy (rev a1b2c3) by sre-lead.

Nisha: manual paging via SMS went through at 13:18, ack from eng-sre within 2m. Customers started to see retries succeed around 13:20.

Leo: after the restart success rate for webhook deliveries climbed back to ~99%. Still seeing a few 5xx while caches and connections warm.

Maya: status update to support: mitigation applied, manual pages used while bot suppressed. Ask product to monitor for any lost events in the payments retry window.

Nisha: immediate action items:
- escalate: check suppression logic on incidentbot (dedupe/window) — may have suppressed legitimate pages
- add alert: pager-proxy 5xx rate >5% for 5m
- add retry path: when PD shows delivered but Slack thread not created, attempt a secondary thread creation or send mobile page

Leo: logging note — we saw a mismatch between PD webhook response and our ack path; possible race in dedupe matching PD id vs webhook id. Will own follow-up.

Maya: I'll open a postmortem and SLO impact doc. Assign follow-up to Leo for dedupe window and ops-bot suppression tuning.

ops-bot: incidentbot: incident marked mitigated — monitoring for 30m.

Maya: thanks all. Quick retro: manual fallback worked but automation gap is unacceptable. We need a short playbook update so oncall can trigger mobile page if Slack thread fails. :white_check_mark:
